title: Reconstruction of Fano manifolds from the orthogonal to an exceptional coherent sheaf
summary: Let $X$ and $Y$ be smooth complex Fano manifolds of dimension at least three with very ample anticanonical bundles, and let $\mathcal{E}_X$ and $\mathcal{E}_Y$ be exceptional coherent sheaves on $X$ and $Y$, respectively. We prove that a Fourier--Mukai equivalence $\mathcal{E}_X^\perp\simeq \mathcal{E}_Y^\perp$ implies $X\simeq Y$.
